I am OBSESSED with this mask! My boyfriend and I did one together and the glow this mask gave us is incredible! My skin feels so smooth and soft after using! A must have!

I didn't realize how dull my skin had been until I tried the Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask. This mask seriously helped with my discoloration and brought my skin back to life. After just one use, my complexion looked more even, brighter, and so much more hydrated. The hydrogel collagen mask feels amazing on the skin and stays in place, which I love. The 70% Peachinia really helped improve my skin clarity, and the 2% niacinamide made a noticeable difference in reviving my skin and softening dark areas. My skin felt smoother, firmer, and had that healthy glow without feeling heavy or irritated. Plus, it's fragrance-free, so it's perfect if you have sensitive skin. This is one of those masks that actually shows results, especially if you're dealing with discoloration or dullness. If you want radiant, refreshed skin, this one is definitely worth adding to your routine. Incentive Review

(and as a plus, its pink 🤭🩷) it did wonders for my skin as i had dull and dry skin before using it. as someone with acne-prone, semi-sensitive skin, i recommend this product to everyone, youll love it!

If you're looking for a glowy, brightening mask that also hydrates, this is a fantastic option. I received this product for free in return for an honest review. I've also seen an improvement in my skin's texture, with a new smoothness and a healthy glow. If you are looking for a skincare product that's full of brightening ingredients without harmful ingredients, please give the Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen masks a try. I'm sure you will not be disappointed. This review is for using the mask on African American combination skin type. Another holy grail that's been added to my skincare routine. Best of all, it didn't irritate my sensitive skin at all. I highly recommend this mask! This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

The morning after my retinol nights my skin tends to look like its been through some sort of misunderstanding, but this mask has calmed and brightened the areas I was most focused on. I have slight roseacea and this mask has soothe my cheeks and reduced the pink and left me with a calm, even tone.

avis.titre: 2. Hydrating and Gentle but Not too Much Brightening
avis.texte: I've been using this mask for two weeks on my dry and dull skin and while I didn't notice a major brightening effect it still delivered in other ways. I use it once or twice a week sometimes over a serum and sometimes by itself. It feels cool and refreshing right away and leaves my skin feeling soft and well hydrated by morning especially when I leave it on overnight. It fits well and doesn't slide around which makes it easy to use. While the brightening claims didn't really come through for me I still enjoy how it soothes and hydrates my skin. It's a nice self care moment that leaves my face feeling comfortable and plump.

The combination of collagen helps promote elasticity and firmness, leaving my skin feeling firmer and youthful. In summary, the Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask is a fantastic a

avis.titre: Love To use before wearing makeup
avis.texte: The ANUA Niacin Brightening Collagen Sheet Mask is a total lifesaver when my skin needs a quick boost, especially before makeup. I have textured skin, so I like to use it right before getting ready, and it instantly makes everything smoother. The sheet is soft and fits well, soaking my skin in a ton of serum without feeling sticky. After 20 minutes, my face feels super hydrated, plump, and refreshed, and it gives me a nice bright glow that makes my foundation apply way more evenly. The niacinamide helps even out dull areas while collagen keeps my skin soft and bouncy. It's gentle, lightweight, and perfect if your makeup for a special event, I would continue this for anytime I need to look fresh and radiant fast, with simple application and no to make any mess when removing.

This mask feels like a burst of hydration and glow in one go. Infused with 70% peach extract and Niacinamide, it gives my dull, sensitive skin an instant pick-me-up. I usually pop it on after a long day or whenever I need a skin reset, and the glow afterward is unreal—plump, dewy, and brightened without redness or tightness. It also helps soothe my skin when it's feeling irritated, thanks to its cooling effect. The peach scent is light and pleasant, and the sheet fits comfortably without sliding. Since using it weekly, I've noticed my skin tone looking more even, and my overall radiance has improved. It's my go-to mask when my skin needs TLC and visible brightening.

The Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask is such a unique experience! The color-changing formula melts onto the skin with a cooling, jelly-like texture that feels super refreshing. Enriched with peach water and niacinamide, it leaves my skin noticeably brighter, smoother, and more supple. I love how it firms without feeling tight or drying. Plus, it smells softly fruity without being overwhelming. A fun, effective mask that delivers real glow!

I love how soothing the mask feels as you apply it to your face, It's very relaxing. I went to sleep on my mask and woke feeling the firmness that it gives. When I woke up the mask was lifting and I didn't really like the sides lifting but removing the mask my face look smooth and hydrated. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

First off, I really appreciate that this mask is fragrance-free. My skin is on the sensitive side, and I've had bad reactions to scented masks in the past. This one felt gentle and soothing from the moment I put it on. The hydrogel texture was super comfortable and it stayed in place and didn't drip or slide around like some sheet masks do. One of my favorite things is it didn't leave any sticky residue either, which is a huge bonus. One of the biggest things I noticed was how well it hydrated my skin. Overall if you're looking for a mask that hydrates, brightens, and smooths without irritating your skin, this is it. I love the glow it gives me, and I'll definitely keep a few of these on hand. Highly recommend! This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review

This ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask, and it's sooo good. First of all, it smells like peaches like not too strong, but just enough to make me happy while I put it on. The texture is super soft and creamy, and it spreads really nicely on my skin. I leave it on for like 15 minutes, my face feels so smooth and fresh. I have a bit of uneven skin tone, and after using this a few times, I swear my skin looks way brighter and more even. It has niacinamide and collagen in it, which helps with glow and keeping my skin feeling bouncy. What I really love is that it doesn't feel heavy or sticky. It's super gentle, and I didn't get any breakouts or irritation after using it. My dry patches felt way better too. I usually use it at night, and the next morning my skin looks extra glowy and soft.

I recently tried the ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask and absolutely loved it! The mask comes in two ultra-light hydrogel pieces upper and lower that fit snugly and stay in place for hours. The formula is clean and packed with 70% peach fruit water, 2% niacinamide, low-molecular collagen, and multiple hyaluronic acids. It features a clever color-changing indicator starts opaque peach and turns translucent once fully absorbed. I left it on for about 3 hours and, once it turned clear, removed it to pat in the remaining essence. My skin instantly felt smoother and more hydrated, with a noticeable glow and firmer texture just as Ulta's own testing reported a 13% improvement in skin roughness after one use. I appreciated how breathable and comfortable it was no sticky residue or heaviness. Plus, it's ideal for prepping before an event or an overnight glow up session. A few reviewers noted that the results fade after a few days, but honestly, once a week use is perfect for me.

I loved using the Anua peach 70 niacin brightening mask. I used it after my skincare at night. I cleansed, toned and used a serum before wearing the mask. I loved the glow in the morning! My skin is so much plumper and hydrated and smooth! I loved the texture of the mask and how cool it felt on my skin. The mask is designed to fit perfectly and covers my whole face. My skin has been having mild break outs and the mask really helped in calming and soothing the breakouts. I am very happy with the results!! I like how the mask is not very wet and sticky like other masks that you have to sit still or they fall off. I can go around and finish my night routine with the mask on. This was an amazing addition to my skincare and I would definitely use it again.

This is a two piece collagen gel mask with niacinamide for brightening and smoothing skin texture. It was a little slippery to apply for me, but once on the face it did not move around. It's large enough to comfortably reach to my hairline and just around the jaw line. And since its two pieces, its easier to conform to the skin contour without any wrinkles. This is a 3-4 hour mask, and as the serum absorbs from the mask into the skin, the mask will go from opaque to a translucent pink. I think it is easy for me to fall asleep in the mask, although sometimes in the middle of the night I wake up and take it off if it's been long enough. The next morning, my skin looks dewy and bright and well hydrated. However, throughout the day then my skin becomes a little irritated and flushed , especially in the cheeks. After this happened the first time, I blamed being out in the sun too long the day after , even with SPF. So then after that , I made sure to be hydrated and use soothing products, but same thing occurred (even if indoors all day). The irritation lasts about 2 days. And I'm not new to niacinamide - I love it in my daily serums. The texture of my skin looks great, but the irritation is annoying and not really worth it. So this may be good for some people , however maybe not if you have sensitive skin. The quality of the mask itself is good though. I probably will not get again, and will just stick to serums. **This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange fo

This mask truly wowed me. It hugs the skin and stays on even if I'm moving around. It's incredibly hydrating and cooling from the moment you put it on. The combination of peach extract, niacinamide, and collagen gives my skin a radiant, luminous finish. I use it overnight and wake up with a visibly brighter, more even complexion. I've used brightening masks before, but they often irritate my skin—this one is gentle, soothing, and effective. 've noticed my hyperpigmentation lightening and overall skin tone improving using Anua Peach 70 products. This has definitely earned a permanent spot in my weekly skincare routine! The peach‑derived niacinamide and collagen left my complexion radiant and even-toned by morning. Between this mask and the Rice Glow, i'm in love.

51 year old beauty enthusiast excited to try the Anua Peach 70 Brightening Collagen masks. Definitely use as either an overnight mask or just leave on a few hours before bed. The mask will become translucent when treatment is complete. Mask is very cold when sitting at room temperature. If ypu don't like that sort of thing, warm the package by placing in a bowl of warm water for a few minutes Mask is very easy to apply but it is fragile due to the composition. I have to make tiny tears for it to fit around my nose (have a nose ring) and fit my eyes. It does come in two pieces, bottom of face and top of face. Peels off very easy. I did not experience any bad side effects with use. My skin felt and looked great with each use! I would definitely consider purchasing and using again.

You'll need to leave these on for several hours to get the most benefit out of it (mask will turn opaque and moisture will penetrate into your skin and dry out). I prefer leaving this one on overnight—which is recommend by the brand. It stays in place without sliding around and feels super comfortable. There's no fragrance, and the material gives a nice cooling sensation when applied. I woke up with incredibly plump, hydrated skin. The mask changes from opaque to clear as it works. It comes in two pieces, making it easy to fit any face shape, and the material is durable—I adjusted it several times without any tearing. Removal is simple, and my skin was left smooth, glowing, and irritation-free. This product was gifted for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

I am hesitant to try brightening mask but because I trust Anua, I decided to try this one. It has a slight peach smell that I liked. I have combination skin and it did not leave my skin dry or oily, it was just right! It helped my skin feel more glowy. I would recommend this! Anua is a great line and this mask if a great product. Since I loved the Anua Peach 70 Niacin serum, I was absolutely stoked to try it in mask form. Lemme tell you…it did not disappoint. The mask is cool and calming on the skin and has been a lifesaver in the summer heat. It hydrates while gently exfoliating away dullness and dead skin. Or, like I said, amazing when you need a pick-me-up after a long hot day. If you are already a fan of the serum, the mask is a great addition. This product was provided in exchange for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

I liked this face mask. It reminds me of the rice one they have, but it's supposed to lighten the skin. I didn't notice any overall results within the four face masks that I tried, however, I feel like this is an adequate mask to use with a brightening routine. If I'm being honest, I mainly used these because they're pink. The mask comes with a sheet of clear plastic to help you remove them safely without tearing them. I do like how big they are; they could have been a little bigger since I have a bigger face, however, I just used these eye holes to cover the parts of my jaw that I didn't cover. I did use some scissors to cut across the nose bridge to make it fit down to my face. I used this mask overnight to get the best results. I felt glowy and would just rinse my face with water and then apply sunscreen. Don't expect results overnight, however, expect improvement with a complementary routine.

I have a dry, combination and acne prone skin. My skin gets very dry during summers so I am always looking for products to hydrate my skin without stripping it. This mask felt very cool on application and was very easy to apply as it did not have any sticky essence like other sheet masks. It was made with collagen and peach extract which gave it a jelly like texture, calming scent and a cooling effect. I used this as a overnight mask and waited until the mask became transparent and everything was absorbed into my skin. My skin felt glowy, smooth and soft after using the mask. It also felt hydrated and the glow lasted for 2-3 days. The mask did not have a slippery texture and that made it comfortable to use as a overnight mask because it stuck properly on face. I've used this mask a few times and really like it. It goes on easily and stays on your face well. Since it's two pieces it fits on your face nicely. I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I liked how soft and renewed my skin felt after using this mask. I had issues getting to to fit my face right and the bottom half kept trying to slide off but it just took my readjustments to use it.

I think this would work great for anyone that wants glass skin. I would also definitely recommend these for anyone that wants to treat some moderate discoloration.

I do think that this helps with skin texture, but I don't think it's going to happen with only one use. I did like it, but I prefer the Anua rice mask.

avis.titre: Instant glow + juicy hydration in one mask
avis.texte: This mask is pure joy to use. The scent is soft and fruity, never overpowering, and the texture feels light and cooling — exactly what I want at the end of a long day. Every time I use it, my skin looks visibly fresher, more even, and so glowy. It hydrates without leaving any residue and gives that "well-rested" look even when I'm running on little sleep. The niacinamide and peach extract make such a beautiful combo — calming, brightening, and plumping all at once. I use it 2–3 times a week when my skin feels dull, and it always brings life back to my complexion.

This mask is great to use overnight or during the day but i will say it takes a really long time on my skin to finally turn transparent. However it feels really nice because it says cool so its very refreshing on my skin. Not sure I can say it instantly brightens my face after one use but my skin definitely feels dewy and clear after using these masks. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

This mask is great to use overnight or during the day but i will say it takes a really long time on my skin to finally turn transparent. However it feels really nice because it says cool so its very refreshing on my skin. ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask is a hydrogel mask infused with peach water, niacinamide, and collagen, leaving your skin smooth, firm, and radiant. Its exclusive PEACHINIA+ complex revitalizes your skin just after a few hours of application. The mask turns transparent after 4 to 5 hours (can be used as an overnight mask), depending on your skin texture. After using 1 sheet of mask, my skin looks visibly firm and radiant. It contains low molecular collagen, which helps all the beneficial ingredients absorb into the skin. It's comfortable, breathable, and 100% irritation-free. The box contains 4 individually packed face masks, and each mask comes with 2 pieces, one for the upper face and one for the lower face. The mask is thicker at the beginning of your application. Gradually, your skin soaks up all the gel from the mask. It's easy to remove once dried. I would recommend this product 10/10 to anybody whose skin needs hydration, firmness, and smooth texture. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

These Anua peach brightening face masks are really nice. They have ingredients like Peachinia, Niacinamide, and Soluble Collagen. Non scented. Super gentle. They are nice and saturated. Which is great because it keeps the masks from falling off. The mask itself fits well. It comes in two pieces. The top half of the face and the bottom. Which is nice since everyone has different size faces. I actually prefer this to a whole sheet mask. Much more comfortable. The mask is like a jelly material. There are two ways to do it. You can use it as a quick mask or leave it on over night. Its colored changing. It goes from pink to transparent when it's done. Which is a neat feature. You can use the eye and mouth pieces to do your neck and chest afterwards. After use my skin looked radiant, felt smoother and firmer. It also helps to improve skin clarity and balance. This was a perfect step in my skincare routine. These are also priced affordable at 5 dollars a piece when you buy the 4 pack which is a great price these days. Would highly recommend. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Dewy Skin in One Dreamy Step
avis.texte: Having used the ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask, I can confidently say it's a glow-up essential. The ultra-thin hydrogel sheet hugs the skin like a second layer, gradually turning transparent as its peach water, niacinamide, and low molecular collagen soak in. I love how it delivers deep hydration and a noticeable brightening effect overnight—my skin looked smoother, plumper, and more even-toned by morning. It's gentle, fragrance-free, and perfect for sensitive skin. The two-piece design fits snugly and doesn't budge, even if you toss and turn. Highly recommended for anyone craving a radiant, glass-skin finish with minimal effort. It's become my go-to for pre-event prep or when my skin needs a serious pick-me-up. Product was received as part of an educational promotion.

I love how this mask brightened my facial skin almost immediately. It is super easy to use; it has two halves (although it is very easy to cut them further if you would like) that go on the skin smoothly without a mess. Unlike regular sheet masks, hydrogel masks can be left on overnight, but three to four hours are recommended at a minimum for best absorption. The great ingredients in these hydrogel masks ensure hydration and brightening of the skin, such as niacinamide, collagen, and a great amount of leather fruit water for revitalization! I use it once a week as part of my skincare routine. I previously had a significant amount of roughness and dark spots, uneven skintone but these masks have greatly improved the appearance of my skin and restored my barrier. The product was received as part of an educational promotion.

These are easy to use good quality masks. I used these masks as recommended after cleansing my face and applying a toner. These masks are recommended to be worn until they turn transparent or as a sleeping mask. I prefer to wear them overnight. They are comfortable to sleep in. avis.titre: I love the way my skin looked after this mask!
avis.texte: The Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask impressed me way more than I expected it to! It noticeably brightened and tightened my skin after just one use, and I could already see a difference in some of the dark spots left behind by healing acne. My complexion looked more even and refreshed, and my skin felt firmer without any dryness or irritation. I left it on for about an hour, and the mask stayed comfortable the whole time without sliding around or drying out. I'm really happy with how gentle yet effective it was, and I'm curious to see what kind of results I'll get if I try it overnight next time. Definitely one of my new favorites for targeting dullness and post-acne marks. (I received this product as a promotion for educational purposes in exchange for my honest review.)

This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review. I've been using the Anua Peach Collagen Color-Changing Mask for a couple of weeks now, and overall, I'm pretty impressed with it. The hydrogel material is ultra-thin and adheres really well to the skin — it doesn't slide off like some thicker masks. It feels very lightweight, so it's comfortable enough to wear for hours or even overnight (though I usually take it off after a few hours). What's unique is the color-changing effect — it starts with a soft peach tint and turns clear as it "transfers" the ingredients into your skin. It's not just a gimmick; it actually helps indicate that the mask has done its job. I've noticed my skin feels more hydrated and smoother after each use. There's a soft, subtle glow, likely from the niacinamide and peach water blend. My dry areas feel more plump and less flaky. However, if you have very dry or sensitive skin, you might still want to follow up with a thicker moisturizer afterward. It definitely helps with hydration and makes my skin look fresher by morning.

As someone with dehydrated and dull skin, the Anya Leach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask has made a noticeable difference in the texture and appearance of my skin. The combination of niacinamide and soluble collagen has helped firm and smooth my complexion, while the key ingredient, peachinia, has dramatically improved clarity and overall skin health. avis.titre: This Mask Makes My Skin Feel So Good
avis.texte: First off, when I heard that ANUA came out with a peach mask, I knew I had to try it!! I'm a lover of all things peach! The ANUA Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask is different from any other mask that I have tried. It can be applied for multiple hours, so I chose to use this mask overnight while sleeping. This mask comes in two pieces, which I feel makes it easier to apply to my face, since I have a narrow, smaller shaped face. The cutout pieces are nice to use on other areas, such as the neck, and I have even applied to my hands to help brighten some dark spots. I love the feel and texture of the mask, and think it's unique that is is color changing, so if it is used during the day, you will easily know when to remove the mask. I love how hydrating this mask is, and I love how my skin feels after using it. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Satisfied with the Anua's Peach Mask
avis.texte: The Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask has a gel-like texture and is smooth to the touch. I applied it after my night cleansing routine and slept with it on. After removing it, my face felt hydrated and dewy. I would recommend to those looking to achieve radiant skin overnight with a simple mask face routine. You'll wake up with a healthier, brighter complexion with minimal effort. No need to worry about harsh ingredients as Anua focuses on gentle yet effective formulas. I love that Anua values sustainability as well as quality clean ingredients and it shows through their products. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

As a fan of collagen sheet masks, which I find really work to infuse skin with active ingredients, I was eager to try the ANUA Peach 70 + Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask. ANUA's focus on gentle yet effective formulas always piques my interest. For my sensitive skin, comfort is key. This mask delivered perfectly; there were no funny smells and absolutely no stinging sensation while it was on. A big win! I really appreciated that the mask comes in two parts, making it much easier to apply for a perfect fit. I left it on for 20 to 40 minutes, and a fantastic bonus was using it on hot summer days in front of a fan. It felt incredibly refreshing and amazing. The mask is formulated with Peach 70 and Niacin for brightening. After using it, my skin felt a little bit smoother, which was nice. However, I didn't see a dramatic, noticeable difference in overall brightness or tone immediately afterward, which I sometimes hope for from a brightening product. It also claims a color-changing method, but I never noticed any change, even after extended wear. This didn't impact the product's effectiveness, but it was a feature I expected. Despite not seeing a dramatic brightening effect or the color change, I genuinely enjoyed the experience. I loved the collagen texture and how comfortable it felt. I wouldn't hesitate to buy these again for a soothing, smoothing treatment. That said, I might explore other ANUA masks that are more specifically targeted for brightening my skin concerns, just ba

I am obsessed with the Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask from ANUA! One of my skincare priorities is brightening my complexion, so I immediately knew I had to try this product out. This product can be used for both long-form and short-form wear, with the option to wear it overnight. I used the mask for a few hours and was very pleased with the results. The mask is very high-quality and adheres quickly to your skin. Upon removing the mask, my skin was dewy, glowy and firmer. Whether you're winding down with a book or catching up on emails, the mask stays put and does its job effortlessly. After just 15–20 minutes, skin appeared noticeably more hydrated, calm, and radiant. The peach extract and niacinamide seemed to instantly brighten the complexion without causing any redness or irritation. Dry patches around the nose and cheeks were significantly reduced, and overall skin tone looked fresher and more even. The essence absorbed quickly after removing the sheet, leaving behind a soft, non-tacky finish. Makeup applied smoothly afterward, making it a great pre-event mask to prep the skin for foundation or BB cream. It's a high-performing, well-balanced product that lives up to its promises. With a clean ingredient list, refreshing scent, excellent fit, and real results, this mask provides the glow and hydration your skin craves. "I received this product in exchanged of my honest opini

After just one use, my skin looked noticeably dewy, plump, and smoother—many users report a ~29% glow boost. I have mixed feelings about this Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask. Here's what's great about it. There is plenty of product inside the envelope and the mask itself - enough to apply on your hands, neck and chest. The mask is super thick and feels nice and cooling on your skin. It's two separate pieces instead of a full piece mask. And although it's a thick mask, it's also very flimsy at the same time and can be difficult to get into place. The mask would lift around the parameter of my face, maybe my face is too small. It also took forever for the mask to turn clear. The directions on my packaging didn't tell you how long to leave it on, so make sure you leave it on for at least 2-4 hours. I use face masks daily and tend to lean towards Korean skincare, so I was excited to give the Anua Peach 70% + Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask a try. I'm 48 years old and followed the instructions carefully. I first tied my hair back into a loose bun to keep it from sticking to the mask. After cleansing, I applied my toner, then opened the packet to find a generously soaked mask with a two-piece design that was separated by a protective film. The upper half fit comfortably around my forehead, eyes, and the bridge of my nose. I then applied the lower half around my mouth and across my cheeks, gently smoothing it into place. There was some extra essence in the pouch, which I patted onto my neck and décolletage. It took about three to four hours for the mask to become almost transparent. When I removed it, my skin had a glasslike, luminous finish, hydrated, fresh, and noticeably brighter. The instructions say you can sleep in it, but personally, I move around too much at night. I'd only consider sleeping in it once it has fully adhered, maybe after hour three or four, since my main concern is that it could shift and tangle in my hair. I was really pleased with the subtle, radiant glow it gave me. As someone with melasma, I especially appreciate the brightening effects. I'll definitely be using this again. It feels like a luxurious treatment that fits perfectly into my skincare routine. This product was provided for promotional purposes in exchange for my honest review.

avis.titre: Brightening and Hydrating, But Slightly Underwhelming
avis.texte: The Anua Peach 70 Niacin Brightening Collagen Mask is a solid option if you want a boost of hydration with some brightening benefits, but it didn't quite blow me away as much as I hoped. The mask feels super soft and comfortable on the skin, and the peach extract combined with niacinamide works well to calm redness and gently even out skin tone over time. I did notice a subtle glow and smoother texture after use, which is always a win. However, the brightening effect is more gradual and subtle rather than an immediate "wow" moment. Hydration-wise, it's decent but not quite as plumping or barrier-repairing as some other masks I've tried. The fit of the sheet is good and it doesn't dry out quickly, which helps maximize the benefits. Overall, it's a reliable, gentle mask great for sensitive or dull skin days, but if you want serious brightening or intense moisture, you might want to supplement with something stronger. Still a worthwhile addition to a skincare routine, just not a game-changer for me. Received this product free for my honest review.
